title: 微型隧道機頂管~Microtunneling pipe jacking
focus: 微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力~Microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading
summary: 本課以微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力為主線，從面壓合力與地下水邊界與泥漿濃度與固體平衡建立系統邊界，再把接頭傳力與墊材接觸、泥水管路損失與流變連到成品管線水密與紀錄。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading. It begins with Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary and Slurry concentration and solids balance, links Joint load transfer and packer contact and Slurry-line loss and rheology, and ends with Finished-pipeline tightness and records. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 面壓合力與地下水邊界~Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary
units.title: 面壓合力與地下水邊界~Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary
units.mechanism: 泥水面壓需與土骨架及孔隙水的穩定條件共同評估，壓力乘圓面積只是作用合力。高程差使掌子面上下水壓不同，局部滲透又影響有效應力；不能將這個合力當成面前土體所需支護的完整判準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應；若出現使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Slurry face pressure must be assessed with soil-skeleton and pore-water stability; pressure times circular area is only a resultant. Elevation creates vertical pressure variation and seepage changes effective stress. This resultant alone does not establish the support needed for the ground ahead of the machine. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile to discriminate the cause. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡~Slurry concentration and solids balance
units.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡~Slurry concentration and solids balance
units.mechanism: 回流密度同時受輸入載液、挖出固體及混入水影響，需用兩相質量體積平衡估固體濃度。輸入載液若已有固體就不能把全部回流固體當新增出土；沉積與密度計偏差也會使瞬時資料不能閉合長時段土量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量；若出現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Return density depends on carrier fluid, excavated solids and incoming water, requiring two-phase balance. Solids already present in the feed cannot be counted as newly excavated ground. Deposition and density-meter bias further prevent instantaneous readings from closing a long-period excavation balance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 開挖體積與進尺一致性~Excavated volume and advance consistency
units.title: 開挖體積與進尺一致性~Excavated volume and advance consistency
units.mechanism: 理論切削體積由切削外徑及實際進尺決定，並非成品管內徑。超挖與面前土體流入會使移除量增加，而含水、膨鬆及分離滯留使地面量測不直接等於原位量；應保留體積換算及輸送延遲。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將刀盤外徑、進尺時戳與延遲修正出土量比對；若出現忽略回流延遲把前段出土誤配後段進尺，掩蓋局部流失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Theoretical cut volume uses cutter diameter and actual advance rather than finished internal diameter. Overcut and face inflow increase removal, while moisture, bulking and separator retention alter surface measurements. Preserve conversion assumptions and transport delay when reconciling excavated volume with progress. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare cutter diameter and advance timestamps with delay-corrected spoil volume. If ignoring return delay assigns earlier spoil to later advance and hides local loss, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 管壁摩阻與長度累積~Pipe skin friction and length accumulation
units.title: 管壁摩阻與長度累積~Pipe skin friction and length accumulation
units.mechanism: 管列軸力沿長度累積，摩阻取決於地層接觸、潤滑與有效應力，前端還有切削與面壓阻力。均勻剪應力模型僅可看長度敏感度，接頭錯位和停機黏著可能使局部阻力突升；總推力不能直接反推唯一摩阻值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照各段推力增量、潤滑紀錄與停機時間；若出現摩阻集中在局部失潤滑段，均勻模型低估該處管節負荷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Axial pipe force accumulates along the drive, with friction controlled by contact, lubrication and effective stress in addition to front resistance. Uniform shear illustrates length sensitivity only. Misalignment and stoppage adhesion can create local increases, so total thrust does not identify a unique friction value. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare thrust increments by segment with lubrication records and stoppage duration. If friction concentrates in a poorly lubricated section and a uniform model understates local pipe loading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 接頭傳力與墊材接觸~Joint load transfer and packer contact
units.title: 接頭傳力與墊材接觸~Joint load transfer and packer contact
units.mechanism: 頂管接頭透過端面與墊材傳遞壓力，曲線、偏轉和端面不平會縮小有效接觸面。墊材壓縮改變接觸分布而非只平均分力；平均承壓偏低仍可能發生邊緣剝落，需與接頭角差及材料壓縮特性一起檢查。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較接頭角差、墊材壓痕及管端裂縫位置；若出現接頭一側失去接觸使另一側壓碎，總推力仍低於名義額定，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Pipe joints transmit thrust through end faces and packers, while curvature, deflection and unevenness reduce effective contact. Packer compression redistributes contact rather than merely averaging force. Low mean stress can coexist with edge spalling, requiring checks against joint angle and packer compression characteristics. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare joint angularity, packer impressions and pipe-end crack locations. If loss of contact on one side crushes the opposite edge despite thrust below the nominal rating, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 雷射坡度與基準傳遞~Laser grade and datum transfer
units.title: 雷射坡度與基準傳遞~Laser grade and datum transfer
units.mechanism: 重力管線的坡度依賴長距高程一致性，雷射線、機頭姿態及管列中心線是不同量。折射、支架位移和發射點重設會造成共同偏差，不能靠同一儀器重複讀值排除；接收井閉合與獨立水準可提供外部檢核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對雷射基準、獨立水準及管底實測高程；若出現發射架位移使整段同向偏移，機內導向仍顯示接近目標，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Gravity pipelines depend on consistent elevation over distance; laser line, machine attitude and pipe centerline differ. Refraction, mount movement and transmitter resets introduce shared bias that repeated readings cannot remove. Receiving-shaft closure and independent leveling provide external checks on the transferred datum. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check laser reference, independent leveling and measured pipe-invert elevation. If transmitter-mount movement shifts a whole drive while onboard guidance still reports near-target position, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 泥水管路損失與流變~Slurry-line loss and rheology
units.title: 泥水管路損失與流變~Slurry-line loss and rheology
units.mechanism: 輸送管的壓損受流速、管徑、彎頭及泥漿流變影響，清水形式的摩擦係數不能任意套用高濃度漿體。等效牛頓流體算例只是量級比較，沉積還會改變有效管徑；泵端壓力不能代表機頭艙壓。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較管路分段壓差、流量與泥漿流變及沉積檢查；若出現把泵壓上升當成面壓增加，漏掉管內堵塞與輸送衰退，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Transport losses depend on velocity, diameter, fittings and slurry rheology; a water friction factor cannot be assumed for concentrated slurry. An equivalent-Newtonian example is a scale check, while deposition changes effective diameter. Pump discharge pressure does not directly represent face-chamber pressure. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare sectional pressure loss, flow and slurry rheology with deposition checks. If treating rising pump pressure as rising face pressure misses blockage and reduced transport, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 地表槽形與體積推估~Surface troughs and volume estimates
units.title: 地表槽形與體積推估~Surface troughs and volume estimates
units.mechanism: 橫向沉陷槽積分可估每延米地表體積損失，但槽寬、最大沉陷與基準誤差需共同擬合。高斯形只是特定土層情境的近似，建物、地下水和多管線互動可破壞對稱；地表損失也不必等於當時出土超量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形；若出現只量中心點就套固定槽寬，錯估受影響區域與體積損失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Integrating a transverse settlement trough estimates surface volume loss per unit length, requiring joint assessment of width, peak and datum error. A Gaussian is an approximation for particular ground conditions; buildings, groundwater and adjacent drives can break symmetry. Surface loss need not equal contemporaneous excess spoil. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks. If measuring only the center and imposing a fixed width misestimates affected area and volume loss, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 接收井水壓與破口界面~Receiving-shaft pressure and opening interfaces

units.mechanism: 機頭到達接收井時，土體及井壁的水密邊界會改變，開口的水壓合力需用對應水頭計算。井內外水位、封口和地層滲透共同決定流動風險；靜水力算例不能代替經核定的接收與隔離設計。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將接收開口高程、內外水位及封口試驗資料對齊；若出現接收前水位升高未更新壓差，原有封口假設失效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Arrival changes groundwater boundaries at the shaft wall and ground interface; calculate opening force using the relevant head. Internal and external levels, seals and permeability jointly determine inflow risk. A hydrostatic force example does not replace an approved reception and isolation design. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Align receiving-opening elevation, internal and external levels and seal-test evidence. If a pre-arrival water-level rise invalidates the pressure difference assumed for the seal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 成品管線水密與紀錄~Finished-pipeline tightness and records
units.title: 成品管線水密與紀錄~Finished-pipeline tightness and records

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查面壓合力與地下水邊界：uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN；再獨立檢查泥漿濃度與固體平衡：Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s。假定推力 1200 kN 不變，有效接觸面從 0.30 減到 0.15 m2 時，平均接頭承壓由 4 增至 8 MPa；局部峰值可能更高。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 將用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN. Independently check Slurry concentration and solids balance: Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s. At an assumed 1200 kN thrust, reducing effective contact from 0.30 to 0.15 m2 doubles mean joint bearing from 4 to 8 MPa; local peaks may be higher. The two results are not a complete design because slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. Use test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。FHWA 公開章節區分 HDD、頂管與微型隧道，PJA 資料提供管列荷載與公差的閱讀脈絡；城市管線走廊為假想場景，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. FHWA distinguishes HDD, pipe jacking and microtunneling; PJA provides reading context for pipe loads and tolerances. The urban utility corridor is a hypothetical setting. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
